values.description: The API root. Change the port here if PORT in .env is not 3000.
Set automatically by Login and Refresh session in the auth-context collection. Read by every protected request in all three collections.
Set by Login and rotated by Refresh session. Presenting it is the authentication, so treat it as a credential.
The account all three collections act on. Create user (user context) registers it and Login (auth context) verifies against it, so they can never drift apart.
12 to 128 characters, no composition rules. Rewritten by Change password and Reset password.
The replacement used by Change password and Reset password.
Paste from the email Mailpit captured at http://localhost:8025. Not obtainable over HTTP.
Paste from the password-reset email in Mailpit. Not obtainable over HTTP.
